description: This file is a Go source file implementing a controller for managing differential operations in a repository comparison tool. It includes functions for executing differentials, managing manifests, running external scripts, processing CSV data, and persisting entities related to repository differences.

classes.name: ent.ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for application settings including directories, URLs, and branches.

classes.name: ent.DiffTarget
classes.description: Represents a differential target with upstream and downstream manifest URLs and branches.

classes.name: ent.ManifestFile
classes.description: Represents a manifest file entity parsed from XML.

classes.name: ent.ManifestFileGroup
classes.description: Group of manifest files including common, upstream, and downstream manifests.

classes.name: ent.DiffRow
classes.description: Entity representing a row of diff data between repositories.

classes.name: ent.CommitRow
classes.description: Entity representing commit data associated with diffs.

methods.name: ExecuteDifferentials
methods.description: Main function to execute all differential processes based on configuration.

methods.name: defineCommonManifest
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the common manifest file from the upstream repository.

methods.name: createWorkingPath
methods.description: Creates a directory path for processing.

methods.name: printFunctionDuration
methods.description: Utility to print the duration of a function execution.

methods.name: clearOutputDirectory
methods.description: Removes all files from the output directory before processing.

methods.name: setupCommand
methods.description: Prepares an external command to run the differential Python script.

methods.name: runPyScript
methods.description: Runs the differential Python script and retrieves the generated CSV files.

methods.name: diffTarget
methods.description: Executes the differential target script and manages its runtime.

methods.name: TransferScriptOutputToDownstream
methods.description: Processes the CSV outputs and persists the diff and commit data into repositories.

methods.name: loadTargetManifests
methods.description: Loads manifest files for upstream and downstream from disk.

methods.name: readCSVFiles
methods.description: Reads and converts CSV files into diff and commit row entities.

methods.name: persistEntities
methods.description: Persists the diff and commit entities into repositories.

methods.name: csvFileToDiffRows
methods.description: Converts a CSV file into a list of DiffRow entities.

methods.name: toDiffRows
methods.description: Casts generic entities into DiffRow slices.

methods.name: CSVFileToCommitRows
methods.description: Converts a CSV file into a list of CommitRow entities.

methods.name: toCommitRows
methods.description: Casts generic entities into CommitRow slices.

methods.name: persistDiffRowsDownstream
methods.description: Inserts diff rows into the persistent storage through the project repository.
